2.198.5
RadialScale.GaugeMinorTickMarks
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The RadialScale.GaugeMinorTickMarks element specifies the minor tick marks to display on a
RadialScale. This element is optional. This element is of type GaugeTickMarks.
The following is the parent element of the RadialScale.GaugeMinorTickMarks element.
Parent elements
RadialScale
The following is the XML Schema definition of the RadialScale.GaugeMinorTickMarks element.
 <xsd:element name="GaugeMinorTickMarks" type="GaugeTickMarksType" minOccurs="0" />
